🎥 自由攝影機 3.0

A lightweight, fully client-side cinematic camera toolkit for Minecraft.

Available for Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge on Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2.

Fly freely, orbit around your subject, lock the camera in place, follow entities, record camera movement, and create smooth keyframe paths — all without moving your real player.

✨ Camera Modes

🕊️ Free Camera

Detach the camera and explore freely using WASD, mouse, Space, and Shift.

🔄 Orbit

Create smooth rotating shots around your player with adjustable distance and height.

📌 Tripod

Lock the camera in place while controlling your character normally.

🎯 Follow

Follow players, mobs, boats, minecarts, armor stands, and other supported entities.

Includes four profiles:

  • Chase
  • Side
  • Fixed Angle
  • Look At

🎬 Cinematic Tools

  • Smooth cinematic movement
  • Continuous 360° camera roll
  • Smooth configurable zoom
  • Off, Soft, and Vanilla collision modes
  • Camera movement recording and playback
  • Keyframe-based camera paths
  • Linear and smooth Catmull-Rom interpolation
  • Loop, reverse, and ping-pong playback
  • Optional cinematic letterbox
  • Customizable camera status HUD

🕹️ Controls

Key Action
F6 Activate or deactivate the camera
Hold F6 Open the radial mode menu
F9 Toggle Cinematic mode
F10 Open settings
G Select a Follow target
Z / C Roll right / left
V Hold to zoom
R Straighten roll, then reset the camera
WASD Camera or mode-specific movement
Space / Shift Vertical movement
Scroll Adjust speed or distance

All controls are rebindable.

⚙️ Built-In Settings

Press F10 to open the complete settings screen.

Customize:

  • Movement speed and smoothing
  • Orbit and Follow behavior
  • Collision modes
  • Roll and zoom
  • HUD visibility
  • View bobbing and hurt shake
  • Recording and path playback
  • Cinematic presets

Mod Menu is optional.

🎞️ Recording & Paths

Record your final visible camera movement, then play it back with adjustable speed, looping, reverse playback, roll, and zoom.

Create cinematic paths by adding camera keyframes and choosing their duration, easing, and interpolation.

Files are stored locally in:

  • config/free-camera/recordings/
  • config/free-camera/paths/

🛡️ Client-Side Safety

  • No server installation required
  • Does not move your real player
  • Does not modify player physics
  • Does not manipulate movement packets
  • Does not force chunk loading
  • Does not modify followed entities
  • Cleans up safely after death, disconnect, dimension changes, and perspective changes

Some multiplayer servers may restrict free-camera mods. Always follow the server's rules.

✅ Current Release

Free Camera 3.0.0

Platform Minecraft Required Version
Fabric 26.1.2 Fabric Loader 0.18.5+ and Fabric API 0.145.4+26.1.2
Fabric 26.2 Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ and Fabric API 0.154.2+26.2
Forge 26.1.2 Forge 64.0.12+
Forge 26.2 Forge 65.0.6+
NeoForge 26.1.2 NeoForge 26.1.2.84+
NeoForge 26.2 NeoForge 26.2.0.28-beta+
  • Requires Java 25
  • Fully client-side
  • Server installation is not required

Make sure you download the correct file for your Minecraft version and mod loader.
